units.source_text: 对我突然的畏缩，姑娘投以白眼，坐起身子来了，

en.t: At my sudden shrinking back, the girl gave me a cold look and sat up,

units.source_text: 然后她把腰身扭过去，背向着我，从手提包里掏出一面镜子照了照。

en.t: then twisted her waist away, turned her back to me, and took a mirror from her handbag to look at herself.

units.source_text: 她不言语，可是她的轻蔑却千遍万遍地刺着我的肌肤，

en.t: She said nothing, but her contempt pricked my skin thousands upon thousands of times,

units.source_text: 宛如秋天的牛藤果扎在衣裳上一样。

en.t: like autumn cocklebur burrs catching on one's clothes.
